selection_policy: Primary research papers and official evaluation/optimization repositories for reflection, self-refinement, skill learning and reproducible evaluation.

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
supports: episodic verbal reflection used to improve subsequent attempts
limitations: Self-reflection does not prove causal diagnosis or production safety

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
limitations: Generator and critic may share blind spots
No independent promotion or effect governance

sources.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
limitations: Game environment differs from real software/laboratory authority and safety

sources.title: DSPy Documentation
supports: programmatic optimization of LM programs against metrics/examples
limitations: Metric/data quality and production governance remain application responsibilities

sources.title: OpenAI Evals
limitations: Repository framework does not define Aurora domain evaluation or promotion

sources.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
supports: importance of reproducible task instances and tests
limitations: Public benchmark contamination and transfer to local projects require care
